title: Synthetic critical-material source qualification
question: Should the synthetic alternate source enter bounded qualification, and under what evidence conditions?

known: Synthetic supplier records and test artifacts are preserved with SHA-256 provenance.
The synthetic evidence package contains repeatable device and process measurements.
Production capacity, long-duration reliability, and field performance remain unresolved.
assumed: Additional synthetic lots may provide enough evidence for bounded qualification.
Independent test replication would materially improve confidence.
unknown: Whether the measured performance can be reproduced across synthetic lots.
Whether the alternate source can sustain the declared delivery window.

uncertainties.label: Evidence repeatability
uncertainties.description: How consistently decision-relevant evidence repeats during the qualification window.

uncertainties.label: Independent test outcome
uncertainties.description: Whether independent tests reproduce the declared performance and reliability envelope.

uncertainties.label: Available deployment budget
uncertainties.description: Resources available for test calibration, hardware, operations, and independent review.

objectives.label: Evidence gain
objectives.description: Expected ability to increase decision-relevant evidence quality.

objectives.label: Affordability
objectives.description: Ability to remain within realistic financial and operating limits.

objectives.label: Supply continuity
objectives.description: Ability to maintain supply within the declared operating and delivery envelope.

objectives.label: Reversibility
objectives.description: Ability to stop, revise, or redirect the strategy without disproportionate loss.

relationships.statement: Additional synchronized viewpoints can improve corroboration and enable geometric reconstruction when timing and test calibration are sufficient.
Controlled known-target testing can reduce false-positive risk before larger deployment.
A staged strategy preserves the option to scale after defined evidence and repeatability triggers are met.

strategies.label: Review existing evidence only
strategies.description: Complete test calibration review, metadata recovery, and controlled comparison without new field infrastructure.
strategies.action_now: Complete source, test calibration, and known-target review.
strategies.monitor: Residual unexplained signatures and repeatability reports.
strategies.trigger: Escalate if controls remain unresolved and repeatability is moderate or high.
strategies.contingency: Close or archive the case if controls explain the result adequately.

strategies.label: Qualify alternate source immediately
strategies.description: Purchase, calibrate, and operate a synchronized two-qualification path collection system now.
strategies.action_now: Acquire and deploy two synchronized qualification paths.
strategies.monitor: Capture quality, repeatability, operating cost, and community impact.
strategies.trigger: Continue while evidence gain remains material and operating limits are met.
strategies.contingency: Suspend deployment if cost or privacy thresholds are exceeded.

strategies.label: Stage conditional qualification
strategies.description: Finish controls and test calibration, prepare the second qualification path, and deploy only after explicit repeatability and quality triggers are met.
strategies.action_now: Complete controls, calibrate the first qualification path, and prepare a second synchronized unit.
strategies.monitor: Recurrence frequency, control similarity, source quality, and budget readiness.
strategies.trigger: Deploy when calibrated results recur and remain unresolved after controls.
strategies.contingency: Remain in low-cost monitoring mode if the trigger is not met.

scenarios.label: Low repeatability and controls explain most signatures
scenarios.description: Observations are rare and known-target tests reproduce the principal measurement pattern or motion patterns.

scenarios.label: Moderate repeatability with residual uncertainty
scenarios.description: Some conventional controls fit, but a repeatable residual remains unresolved.

scenarios.label: High repeatability and controls remain unresolved
scenarios.description: Calibrated results recur and conventional controls do not reproduce the relevant signatures.

scenarios.label: Useful repeatability but constrained funding
scenarios.description: Collection remains potentially valuable, but available deployment resources are limited.

human_decision.rationale: The staged strategy preserves immediate learning while avoiding unconditional infrastructure cost before repeatability and control-test triggers are met.
human_decision.next_action: Complete known-target controls and publish the second-qualification path deployment trigger checklist.

act_now: Complete camera test calibration and known-target controls.
Prepare the second qualification path without activating full deployment.
triggers: At least two calibrated residual results within the defined review window.
Known-target tests fail to reproduce the decision-relevant signature.
Second-qualification path timing and test calibration readiness pass validation.
contingencies: Remain in single-qualification path monitoring if repeatability is low.
Close or reclassify the case if controls explain the result.
Seek independent review after synchronized corroboration.
adaptive_pathway.reassessment: Review after 90 days or immediately after a trigger event.
